selection_reason: Original LLaDA generator before the later iLLaDA and end-of-thinking extensions; this exact snapshot includes an MIT license.

integration_contract.cache: The calling adapter must force use_cache=False for every model forward; no past_key_values are supplied or reused.
integration_contract.stopping: Fixed steps, no early EOS stop; retain and report any residual MASK.
integration_contract.model_compatibility: The generator uses model.device and model(...).logits. Execution uses the shared extended model. Original-model parity is evaluated separately for specific inputs and settings; see docs/reviews/gsm8k-validation-2026-11-10.md.
